When the words find a voice

Songs

Tere Paas Mai

Original song, written by Sujal Negi

0:00 / 4:00
Lyrics

Verse 1Tere paas mein jab bhi aata hoon main
Khud se zyada tujhmein rehta hoon main
Har saans mein tera zikr ho jaata hai
Tu kahe ya na kahe, sab keh jaata hai

Pre-ChorusTeri khamoshiyon mein bhi baatein hain meri
Tere aansuon mein bhi muskaan hai meri

ChorusTere paas mein, bas tere paas mein
Duniya se door hoon main
Tere saath mein, sirf tere saath mein
Har dard bhi noor hoon main

Verse 2Chand se maanga tha ek noor sa tu
Mil gaya tu toh har dard bhi sukoon
Tere haathon mein likhi meri rahein
Mere khwaabon mein ab sirf tu hi tu

Pre-ChorusTere haathon ki lakeeron mein basa hoon
Tere palkon ke tale khwabon jaisa hoon

ChorusTere paas mein, bas tere paas mein
Jee loon toh bas yun hi main
Tere saath mein, sirf tere saath mein
Kho doon main khud ko bhi main

BridgeNa ho tu toh lage kuch bhi adhura
Na ho tu toh lage sab kuch bezar
Tere hone se hai sab kuch pyaara
Tu hai toh hai sab kuch yaar

Final ChorusTere paas mein, bas tere paas mein
Main hoon jahan tu ho wahin
Tere saath mein, sirf tere saath mein
Zindagi likhi hai yahin

Verse 1Whenever I come close to you,
I live in you more than in myself.
Every breath ends up speaking of you,
Whether you say it or not, it all gets said.

Pre-ChorusEven in your silences, there are words of mine,
Even in your tears, there is my smile.

ChorusClose to you, just close to you,
I am far away from the world.
With you, only with you,
Even in every pain, I am light.

Verse 2I had asked the moon for a light like you,
Once I found you, even pain turned to peace.
My paths are written in your hands,
And in my dreams now, it is only you.

Pre-ChorusI live in the lines of your palms,
Beneath your eyelids, I am like a dream.

ChorusClose to you, just close to you,
If I live, let me live just like this.
With you, only with you,
I would lose even myself.

BridgeWithout you, everything feels incomplete,
Without you, everything feels joyless.
Because you are here, everything is lovely,
Because you are here, everything is, my friend.

Final ChorusClose to you, just close to you,
Wherever you are, that is where I am.
With you, only with you,
My life is written right here.

The Curse of Love

Written by Sujal Negi for the short film The Curse

0:00 / 1:07
Lyrics

Twilight's grasp
A loved one's bright and shrouded in eternal night
A haunting tale of twisted fate
Caught by a curse
A tragic weight.

Shadowed soul
Consumed by fear
A lover's torn
Echoing here

The curse of love
A chilling sound
Forever trapped
In darkness bound

A lover's plea
A desperate cry for mercy's sake
Let freedom fly
But fate has sealed a cruel decree
The curse of love eternally.
